description: This file defines a React component named ShelfView that displays different categories of books (Reading, To Read, Read, Did not finish) using ShelfCarousel components. It manages its state with lists of books for each category and a search text, rendering carousels for each category.

classes.name: ShelfView
classes.description: A React component that displays categorized book carousels based on the user's reading status.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the ShelfView component's state with book lists and search text from props.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the component, displaying four ShelfCarousel components for each book category.
